dct_title_s: Building Damage Assessment in Shyamnagar Upazila, Bagerhat District, Khulna Division, Bangladesh as of 10 June 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240502BGD, GDACS ID: 1001064** This map illustrates potentially affected structures as observed by using a WorldView-2 satellite image acquired on 10 June 2024 at 10:42 Local Time. Within the analysis extent, UNOSAT identified 45 damaged structures and 185 potentially damaged structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
